title: REQ · A shadcn-style Dialog wrapper exposes Radix dialog parts
summary: ui/dialog.tsx re-exports styled Radix dialog primitives
description: Context: only button.tsx exists in src/components/ui. Desired behavior: a dialog.tsx wrapper exports Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogDescription and DialogClose built on @radix-ui/react-dialog, in the same forwardRef plus cn style as button.tsx. Expected result: any component can compose an accessible modal. Why: single reusable accessible base.
acceptance_criteria: Given DialogContent inside an open Dialog, when rendered, then an element with role dialog exists in the document
Given DialogTitle and DialogDescription are rendered, then the dialog has aria-labelledby and aria-describedby pointing at them
Given a className prop on DialogContent, then it is merged with the base classes via cn
